name: Menus help
description: Help mode entries for the Menus plugin (smart menus).
author: Brett

entries.title: Menus
entries.text: Smart sections in every menu and how every menu looks. The menu's own items never move; Talking about, Pinned, Suggested and items for this target sit above them.

entries.title: Menus settings
entries.text: Sections, behaviour, look, per-menu overrides, Talking about and learning for every context menu and app menu.

entries.title: Sections
entries.text: Which dynamic sections every menu shows, in what order, how many items each, and their labels. The menu's own items always stay last, in their own order.

entries.title: Menu look
entries.text: Colours (picked from the theme, so a theme swap still restyles menus), fonts, sizes, corners, width, animation and hover. Changes apply to every menu in every app at once.

entries.title: Live preview
entries.text: A sample menu drawn by the real menu renderer with the look you are editing, every section shown.

entries.title: Menu section
entries.text: A dynamic section of this menu (Talking about, Pinned, Suggested or For this). Tap the heading to fold or unfold it.

steps.say: This is where every menu's smart sections and look are set. The menus' own items never move.
Start with Sections to pick what shows above each menu, or Look to restyle every menu.
